description: Original bilingual summaries of primary sources. Curated snapshot, with company news checked through agent-assisted primary-source review; not live market data, investment advice, or verbatim source copies. updated_at denotes local review rather than source publication; company news has separate publication and event dates.

documents.title: 分散投资与资产配置 / Diversification
documents.text_zh: 资产配置是把资金分配到股票、债券和现金等资产类别；分散投资还应考虑行业、地区和单一发行人集中度。它可以降低部分集中风险，却不能保证盈利或消除市场整体下跌风险。买入一只聚焦单一行业的基金或 ETF 不一定实现充分分散。配置取决于目标、期限和承受损失的能力，不存在适合每个人的固定比例。
documents.text_en: Asset allocation divides money across asset classes such as stocks, bonds and cash. Diversification also considers issuer, sector and geographic concentration. It can reduce concentration risk but cannot guarantee profits or prevent market-wide losses. A narrowly focused sector fund or ETF may provide little diversification. Allocation depends on goals, horizon and capacity for losses, rather than a universal percentage.
documents.text: 分散投资与资产配置：资产配置把资金分到股票、债券和现金等类别。分散可降低集中风险，但不能保证盈利或消除市场整体风险。行业 ETF 不一定充分分散；比例取决于目标、期限和风险承受能力。 Asset allocation divides money across stocks, bonds and cash. Diversification across issuers, sectors and regions reduces concentration risk, not all market risk. A sector ETF may remain concentrated. No universal allocation fits everybody.

documents.title: 投资风险与期限 / Risk and time horizon
documents.text_zh: 投资选择应结合资金何时使用、目标和承受本金损失的能力。潜在回报较高通常伴随更大不确定性，承担更多风险并不保证获得更多收益。短期必要开支需要考虑流动性和本金波动。历史业绩不能保证未来表现；声称高收益且无风险的产品应谨慎核查。助手提供教育信息，不作个股买卖、保本或收益承诺。
documents.text_en: Consider when money is needed, the goal and the ability to tolerate principal loss. A higher potential return generally brings more uncertainty; taking additional risk does not ensure a higher realized return. Near-term essential spending requires attention to liquidity and volatility. Historical performance does not guarantee future results. Verify claims of high returns without risk. This assistant provides education, not individual security recommendations or return guarantees.
documents.text: 投资风险与期限：根据资金使用日期、目标和本金损失承受能力选择投资；更高风险不保证更高实际收益。短期必要资金关注流动性和波动。历史业绩不保证未来。 Risk tolerance and time horizon matter. Higher potential returns involve uncertainty, not a promise. Investment principal can be lost. This assistant does not promise returns or recommend individual trades.

documents.title: 复利与定期投入 / Compound interest
documents.text_zh: 复利表示已产生的利息也继续计息。估算需要初始本金、追加投入、期限、利率及复利频率。本项目计算器采用名义年利率按月复利、每月月末追加投入：月利率 = 年利率 / 12；利率为零时直接累加本金和投入。结果是固定利率的假设场景，不代表市场预测，未计税、费用或通胀。实际有效年收益率不能直接除以 12 当作月利率。
documents.text_en: Compounding earns interest on earlier interest. Projections need initial principal, contributions, horizon, rate and compounding frequency. This project's calculator assumes a nominal annual rate compounded monthly and contributions at month-end: monthly rate = annual rate / 12. At zero interest, add principal and contributions directly. This is a fixed-rate scenario excluding tax, fees and inflation, not a market forecast. An effective annual yield cannot simply be divided by 12.
documents.text: 复利：利息继续计息。需要本金、月投入、期限、年利率和复利频率。本项目用名义年利率按月复利、月末投入，月利率=名义年利率/12；零利率时直接累加。未计税费通胀，不是收益承诺。 Compound interest earns interest on interest. Project calculator assumes nominal annual rate/12 and end-of-month contributions, excluding taxes, fees and inflation. Effective annual yield is not nominal annual rate.

documents.title: 名义利率与有效年收益率 / Nominal rate and APY
documents.text_zh: APY（有效年收益率）包含复利影响。在按月复利的简化模型中，名义年利率 r 对应 APY (1+r/12)^12-1；给定 APY y，等效月利率为 (1+y)^(1/12)-1，公式里的 r、y 用小数表示。正 APY 直接除以 12 会高估等效月利率：APY 5% 对应月利率约 0.4074%，不是 0.4167%；APY 为零时月利率也为零。本项目表单输入名义年利率百分数，5 表示 5%。真实披露可能有不同天数和计息规则。
documents.text_en: APY includes compounding. In a simplified monthly model, nominal annual rate r implies APY (1+r/12)^12-1; given APY y, monthly rate is (1+y)^(1/12)-1. Use decimal fractions for r and y in these formulas. Dividing a POSITIVE APY by 12 OVERSTATES the equivalent monthly rate: APY 5% means about 0.4074% monthly, not 0.4167%. Zero APY means zero monthly rate. Project form inputs nominal annual percentages: enter 5 for 5%. Actual disclosures may use different day counts and rules.
documents.text: APY/有效年收益率包含复利。名义年利率r对应APY=(1+r/12)^12-1；给定APY y，月利率=(1+y)^(1/12)-1（r和y为小数）。正APY除以12会高估而非低估月利率：APY5%对应月利率约0.4074%，不是0.4167%；零APY对应零月利率。表单5表示名义年利率5%。 APY includes compounding. Given APY y as a decimal, equivalent monthly rate=(1+y)^(1/12)-1. Dividing a POSITIVE APY by 12 OVERSTATES (not understates) the true equivalent monthly rate. APY 5% corresponds to approximately 0.4074% monthly, not 0.4167%. Zero APY gives zero monthly rate. Nominal annual rate r has APY=(1+r/12)^12-1. Real account day counts and rules can differ.

documents.title: 等额本息与摊还 / Loan amortization
documents.text_zh: 固定利率等额本息贷款每期付款相同，通常前期利息占比较高，后期偿还本金占比增加。同样本金和利率下，期限延长一般降低月供但提高总利息。本项目模型假设每月按时还款、名义年利率按月计息、全额摊还，不计手续费、保险、税费、提前还款或浮息变化。因此模拟月供不等于银行正式报价，应核查贷款合同和费用。
documents.text_en: A fixed-rate fully amortizing loan has equal scheduled payments. Interest generally takes a larger share early, and principal a larger share later. For the same principal and rate, a longer term generally lowers monthly payments but raises total interest. This project assumes monthly payments and nominal annual rate divided by 12, excluding fees, insurance, taxes, early repayment and variable-rate changes. The result is a scenario, not a lender quote.
documents.text: 等额本息贷款固定月供，前期利息占比高、后期本金占比高。延长期限一般降低月供但提高总利息。项目仅模拟固定名义利率按月计息且按期全额摊还，不计费用税费或提前还款。 A fully amortizing fixed-rate loan has equal monthly payments; interest share declines over time. Longer term can lower payment but increase total interest. Simulation excludes fees, taxes and variable rates.

documents.title: 现金流与预算 / Budgeting and cash flow
documents.text_zh: 预算把同一期间的收入与支出放在一起：结余 = 收入 - 支出；收入大于零时，结余率 = 结余 / 收入。结余为负表示这一期间支出超过收入，应检查必要开支、债务偿付和可调整支出。把年度账单换算成月度预留，并考虑收付款时间。50/30/20 只是参考框架，不是适用于每个人的硬性规则；零收入时百分比没有定义。
documents.text_en: Compare income and spending for the same period: surplus = income - expenses. When income is positive, surplus rate = surplus / income. A deficit means spending exceeded income; examine essential costs, debt payments and adjustable spending. Allow monthly amounts for annual bills and consider payment timing. A 50/30/20 split is only a planning heuristic, not a universal requirement. The percentage is undefined when income is zero.
documents.text: 预算/现金流：同期间收入减支出为结余；收入正数时结余率=结余/收入。负结余代表支出超过收入；考虑年度账单的月度预留和收付款时间。50/30/20是经验框架不是统一标准，零收入百分比无定义。 Budgeting compares income with expenses for the same period. Surplus=income-expenses. Savings/surplus rate requires positive income. Include irregular costs and timing; percentage rules are heuristics.

documents.title: 应急储备 / Emergency savings
documents.text_zh: 应急储备是为收入中断、医疗或修理等计划外开支准备的资金。金额取决于必要开支、收入稳定性、家庭责任及可用保障；不能机械地要求每个人储存同样月数。先设可达成的小目标，再逐步增加。资金应关注安全、可及时取用以及适当的存款保障；波动大的投资未必适合近期应急需要。自动储蓄可帮助执行，但需避免透支费用。
documents.text_en: Emergency savings cover unplanned costs such as lost income, medical bills or repairs. The appropriate amount depends on essential spending, income stability, dependants and available protections; one number of months does not fit everyone. Start with an achievable target and build gradually. Consider safety, accessibility and applicable deposit protection. Volatile investments may not meet near-term emergency needs. Automatic transfers can help, provided they do not cause overdraft fees.
documents.text: 应急储备应对计划外医疗、修理或收入中断。金额依必要支出、收入稳定性、家庭责任等而定；从小目标逐步增加。关注安全、流动性及适用存款保障，自动储蓄避免透支。 Emergency fund: money for unexpected costs or loss of income. Target depends on circumstances rather than a universal month count. Keep funds safe and accessible; volatile assets can be unsuitable for near-term emergencies.

documents.title: 通胀与购买力 / Inflation and purchasing power
documents.text_zh: 通胀表示整体价格水平持续上涨，使相同货币通常购买更少商品和服务。名义收入或收益增加不一定代表购买力提高。用一致期间的通胀率 pi 与名义收益 r 估算，实际收益为 (1+r)/(1+pi)-1；r-pi 是较低比率时的近似。个人消费结构可能与总体价格指数不同。这里解释概念，不提供实时通胀数据或任何资产必然抗通胀的承诺。
documents.text_en: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level, reducing what a unit of money can usually buy. A nominal income or return increase need not improve purchasing power. For matching periods, real return = (1+r)/(1+inflation)-1; subtraction is an approximation at low rates. A household's spending mix may differ from a broad price index. This is a concept explanation, not current inflation data or a guarantee that an asset hedges inflation.
documents.text: 通胀降低货币购买力；名义收益不等于实际收益。同期间实际收益=(1+r)/(1+通胀率)-1；相减只是近似。个人消费篮子可能不同于总体指数。 Inflation affects purchasing power. Real return adjusts nominal return for inflation over matching periods. Personal spending can differ from the index. No live inflation figures are provided.

documents.title: ETF 的结构与交易 / ETF basics
documents.text_zh: ETF 把多位投资者的资金组合投资，份额在交易所按市场价格买卖，价格可能高于或低于每份资产净值（NAV）。交易还可能有买卖价差、佣金和持续费用。ETF 不一定被动跟踪指数，也不一定分散或低风险；应查看持仓、目标、费用及风险披露。杠杆或反向产品具有额外复杂性，不能用普通指数 ETF 的直觉代替研究。
documents.text_en: An ETF pools investors' money and its shares trade on an exchange at market prices that can differ from per-share net asset value (NAV). Trading can involve bid-ask spreads, commissions and ongoing expenses. ETFs are not necessarily passive, diversified or low-risk. Review holdings, objectives, fees and risk disclosures. Leveraged or inverse products add complexity and should not be treated as ordinary broad index funds.
documents.text: ETF份额在交易所按市价交易，可与NAV有折溢价；有价差、佣金和持续费用。ETF并非一定被动、分散或低风险；查看持仓目标和风险。 ETF shares trade on exchanges, sometimes above/below NAV. Spreads, commissions and ongoing expenses matter. Not all ETFs passively track an index or diversify; leveraged/inverse products add complexity.

documents.title: 费用与长期回报 / Investment fees
documents.text_zh: 交易费用和持续费用都会降低投资者回报，并减少未来可以复利增长的资金。基金费用率是持续费用的一种，不能代表全部成本；交易价差、佣金、顾问费或账户费可能另计。即使费率看似很小，长期累计影响仍可能明显。应阅读招募说明书及费用表，比较相似产品的总成本，不能仅凭低费用就认定投资适合。
documents.text_en: Transaction and ongoing fees reduce returns and the money left to compound. A fund's expense ratio is one ongoing cost, not necessarily the total: spreads, commissions, advisory and account fees may also apply. Small annual charges can have a substantial cumulative effect. Read prospectuses and fee schedules and compare total costs of similar products. Low fees alone do not establish suitability.
documents.text: 投资费用降低回报及复利基数。费用率不是全部成本，还可能有价差佣金顾问费等。小额持续费用长期累积影响可观，阅读招募说明书和费用表。 Transaction and ongoing fees reduce returns. Expense ratio does not necessarily include all trading/advisory/account costs. Compare total costs; low fees alone do not imply suitability.

documents.title: 债券价格与利率 / Bonds and interest-rate risk
documents.text_zh: 在其他条件相同时，市场利率上升通常使既有固定利率债券价格下降，利率下降则相反；较长期限通常意味着更高利率敏感度。票面利率与到期收益率不同，债券也存在信用、流动性和再投资等风险。持有单只债券到期的结果仍取决于发行人履约及条款；债券基金没有与单只债券相同的固定到期本金安排。政府担保不等于中途市价不波动。
documents.text_en: Other things equal, higher market interest rates generally lower existing fixed-rate bond prices, and lower rates raise them. Longer maturities generally have greater rate sensitivity. Coupon rate differs from yield to maturity; credit, liquidity and reinvestment risks also matter. Holding an individual bond to maturity still depends on issuer performance and terms. A bond fund differs from a single bond maturing at a set date. Government backing does not remove interim price volatility.
documents.text: 固定利率债券价格通常与市场利率反向变化，长期限一般更敏感。票息不等于到期收益率，还有信用流动性再投资风险。债券基金不同于持有单只债券到期。 Fixed-rate bond prices generally move opposite market interest rates. Longer maturity usually increases sensitivity; issuer/default, liquidity and reinvestment risks remain. Government backing does not eliminate interim price volatility.

documents.title: 美国存款保险 / U.S. FDIC deposit insurance
documents.text_zh: 美国 FDIC 的标准存款保险限额为每位存款人、每家 FDIC 承保银行、每种所有权类别 250,000 美元。同一家银行同一类别下的多个账户通常合并计算，不能简单按账户数增加保障。符合条件的存款可受保障，股票、债券和基金等投资产品不属于 FDIC 存款保险。这个美国规则不能套用于中国内地、香港或其他司法辖区；应核实银行和账户资格。此为 2026-11-10 核查快照。
documents.text_en: The U.S. FDIC standard limit is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category. Accounts in the same category at one bank are aggregated; simply opening more accounts does not multiply coverage. Eligible deposits may be insured, while investments such as stocks, bonds and mutual funds are not FDIC-insured deposits. These U.S. rules do not apply to mainland China, Hong Kong or other jurisdictions. Verify bank and account eligibility. Reviewed snapshot: 2026-11-10.
documents.text: 仅美国FDIC：标准限额每存款人每承保银行每所有权类别250,000美元，同类别同银行账户合并；股票债券基金不受FDIC存款保险保障。不适用中国内地或香港。 U.S. only: FDIC standard coverage $250,000 per depositor per insured bank per ownership category; same-category accounts at one bank aggregate. Stocks, bonds and funds are not insured deposits. Verify eligibility and jurisdiction. Reviewed 2026-11-10.

documents.title: 香港存款保障 / Hong Kong deposit protection
documents.text_zh: 香港存款保障计划由香港存款保障委员会管理，合资格存款的保障上限为每位存款人、每家计划成员银行 800,000 港元（2024-10-01 起提高）。除获豁免者外，香港持牌银行是计划成员，但不是所有金融产品或机构都等同受保障存款。存入前核实认可机构、计划成员身份、存款资格和适用条款。此为 2026-11-10 核查的香港规则快照，不能套用于其他地区。
documents.text_en: Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme is administered by the Hong Kong Deposit Protection Board. Eligible deposits are protected up to HK$800,000 per depositor per Scheme member bank, raised from 2024-10-01. Licensed banks are members unless exempted, but not every financial product or institution is a protected deposit. Verify authorized-institution status, Scheme membership and deposit eligibility. This is a Hong Kong rules snapshot reviewed 2026-11-10, not a rule for other jurisdictions.
documents.text: 香港存款保障计划：合资格存款每存款人每计划成员银行最高800,000港元，2024-10-01起提高。需核实认可机构、成员身份和产品资格；非所有金融产品均受保，不适用于其他地区。 Hong Kong DPS protects eligible deposits up to HK$800,000 per depositor per Scheme member bank. Check institution, membership and product eligibility. Hong Kong only; reviewed 2026-11-10.

documents.title: 银行钓鱼与账户安全 / Phishing and account safety
documents.text_zh: 诈骗者可能冒充银行，要求点击链接、下载附件或提供账户资料。不要通过意外消息中的链接登录，也不要向他人透露密码、一次性验证码或 API 密钥。用已知真实的银行应用、官网或卡片号码独立核实，启用多因素验证。如果已经泄露资料或转账，应尽快通过可信渠道联系银行并按所在地渠道报告。来电显示、标志和紧迫措辞都不能证明真实性。
documents.text_en: Scammers can impersonate a bank and request links, attachments or account information. Avoid signing in through unexpected message links, and do not disclose passwords, one-time codes or API keys. Independently verify through a known genuine banking app, website or number on your card; enable multifactor authentication. If information or money was sent, promptly contact the bank through a trusted channel and report locally. Caller ID, logos and urgency are not proof of authenticity.
documents.text: 银行钓鱼：不要点击意外消息链接或向他人提供密码、OTP、验证码、API密钥。通过可信银行应用官网或卡片号码独立核实，启用多因素验证。已泄露资料或转账应尽快联系银行并按所在地报告。 Phishing can impersonate banks. Do not share passwords, OTPs or API keys. Independently verify via a known genuine channel; use multifactor authentication. Contact the bank promptly if compromised.

documents.title: 信用评分与信用报告 / Credit score and report
documents.text_zh: 信用评分是根据信用报告信息预测还款行为的模型结果；并不存在对每个人和所有贷款通用的唯一分数。还款历史、未偿债务、可用信用使用情况、账户年限和新申请等可能影响评分。准时还款、核查报告错误和管理债务是基础做法，但不能保证分数立即提升或贷款获批。CFPB 资料面向美国，其他地区的征信制度和评分模型不同。
documents.text_en: A credit score models repayment behavior using credit-report information; there is no single score for every person and loan. Payment history, unpaid debt, use of available credit, account age and new applications may matter. Timely payments, checking report errors and managing debt are basic practices, but cannot guarantee an immediate score increase or loan approval. The CFPB source describes U.S. credit; other jurisdictions use different reporting systems and models.
documents.text: 信用评分基于信用报告预测还款行为，模型、数据和用途不同可能产生不同分数。还款历史、债务、额度使用情况、账户年限、新申请等影响评分。按时还款核查错误不保证立即提分或贷款获批。 Credit scores use report information to model repayment. Scores vary by model and data; payment history, debt and utilization can matter. U.S. source; other jurisdictions differ.

documents.title: 财务报表入门 / Financial statements
documents.text_zh: 资产负债表反映某一时点的资产、负债和权益，资产 = 负债 + 权益。利润表反映一个期间的收入、费用和利润；现金流量表反映经营、投资与融资现金流，因此账面利润不等于同期现金净流入。还应阅读权益变动、附注及管理层讨论。分析必须结合期间、会计政策和业务背景，单个数字不足以判断投资价值。
documents.text_en: A balance sheet shows assets, liabilities and equity at a point in time: assets = liabilities + equity. An income statement covers revenue, costs and profit over a period. A cash-flow statement records operating, investing and financing flows, so accounting profit is not the same as net cash inflow. Read equity changes, notes and management discussion too. Interpret figures with their periods, accounting policies and business context.
documents.text: 资产负债表是时点快照，资产=负债+权益；利润表与现金流量表覆盖期间，利润不等于现金净流入。阅读附注管理层讨论并结合会计政策。 Financial statements: balance sheet is a snapshot; income and cash-flow statements cover periods. Assets=liabilities+equity. Accounting profit differs from cash flow; notes and business context matter.

documents.title: 股票与股息 / Stocks and dividends
documents.text_zh: 股票代表公司的部分所有权，收益可能来自价格上涨和公司宣布的股息，但价格会下跌，股息也不保证发放。普通股通常带有表决权；优先股在股息和清算顺序上一般优先于普通股，具体取决于条款。公司破产时普通股股东可能损失全部投入。理解所有权、风险和产品条款比只关注过去涨幅更重要；本助手不提供实时股价或个股买卖建议。
documents.text_en: Stocks represent part ownership in a company. Returns may come from price appreciation and declared dividends, but prices can fall and dividends are not guaranteed. Common shares usually carry voting rights; preferred shares generally have priority over common shares for dividends and liquidation, subject to terms. Common shareholders can lose their entire investment in bankruptcy. Understand ownership, risk and terms rather than relying only on past price gains. No live prices or individual trade recommendations are provided.
documents.text: 股票是公司的部分所有权，可能获得价差和股息，也可能亏损，股息不保证。普通股通常有表决权，优先股一般在股息清算顺序优先但须看条款；破产时普通股可能全损。 Stocks represent company ownership. Prices may rise or fall, dividends are not guaranteed. Common shares usually have voting rights; preferred shares generally have dividend/liquidation priority subject to terms. Common shareholders may lose all capital in bankruptcy.

documents.title: 市盈率与财务比率 / Financial ratios
documents.text_zh: 市盈率 P/E = 每股价格 / 每股收益；应注明采用历史还是预测收益，亏损或接近零的收益会使它难以解释。流动比率 = 流动资产 / 流动负债；营业利润率 = 营业利润 / 营业收入。不同产业、期间和会计口径不可机械比较，比率也不能单独证明股票便宜或优质。没有实时股价和经核实财报时，助手不会编造某公司的当前比率。
documents.text_en: P/E equals price per share divided by earnings per share; specify trailing or forecast earnings. Negative or near-zero earnings make interpretation difficult. Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities; operating margin = operating income / revenue. Industry, period and accounting differences limit comparisons. A ratio alone cannot establish that a share is cheap or high-quality. Without verified price and statements, this assistant does not invent current company ratios.
documents.text: P/E市盈率=每股价格/每股收益，区分历史预测，亏损或近零收益难解释。流动比率=流动资产/流动负债，营业利润率=营业利润/收入。比率需结合行业期间口径，不能独立证明低估。 Financial ratios require consistent periods and industry/accounting context. P/E=price/EPS; current ratio=current assets/current liabilities; operating margin=operating income/revenue. No invented current company ratios.

documents.title: 英伟达 SEC 8-K 人事变更 2026年11月11日生效 / NVIDIA Form 8-K Item 5.02
documents.text_zh: 资料核对日为2026-11-15，这是 SEC EDGAR 上公司提交的8-K快照；核对日期不证明11月12日以后没有后续人事变动。报告事件日期为2026-11-11；文件签署及配套新闻稿日期为2026-11-12。Item 5.02载明董事会于2026-11-11接受 Jen-Hsun Huang（黄仁勋）辞去总裁、CEO及董事，立即生效；随后任命 Colette M. Kress 为临时 CEO，她继续担任执行副总裁和 CFO，董事会寻找新 CEO。同日 Harvey C. Jones 被任命为董事长。临时 CEO、正式 CEO 和董事长是不同角色，不能把 Jones 写成 CEO，也不能把 Kress 写成已获正式永久任命。本地解读边界（项目判断，非公司或SEC的明确声明）：这份8-K未提供当前股价、未来股价预测或违法行为的法律定论。公司向 SEC 提交文件不等于 SEC 对所有陈述作独立事实认证。

Interim CEO, permanent CEO and board chair are distinct roles: Jones is not named CEO, and Kress is not named a permanent appointee.
